arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,os,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from organic_growth import POSTS,read_model
from public_group_discovery import public_join_url
from telethon_sessions import inspect,make_memory_client
config=inspect(vault)
model=read_model(vault,config['group'])
assert model['publish_in_owned_channel'] is False and model['owned_channel'] is None,'publication_must_be_disabled'
path=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid()
state=json.loads(path.read_text())
promo=state.get('owned_promotion',{})
assert isinstance(promo,dict)
record=promo.get('@vpncodeiptv')
if not isinstance(record,dict):
 print('LEADS_PREVIOUS_PUBLICATION_NOT_FOUND_IN_STATE')
 raise SystemExit(0)
print('HISTORICAL_POST_RECORD',record.get('status'),'DAY',record.get('day'),'ACCOUNT',record.get('account'),flush=True)
assert record.get('status')=='posted' and record.get('day')=='2026-10-31' and record.get('account')==1,'unexpected_post_provenance'
msg_id=record.get('message_id')
assert type(msg_id) is int and msg_id>0
ordinal=date.fromisoformat(record['day']).toordinal()
expected=POSTS[ordinal%len(POSTS)].format(url=public_join_url(config['group']))
async def undo():
 client=make_memory_client(config['entries'][0],config)
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(),timeout=25)
  assert await asyncio.wait_for(client.is_user_authorized(),timeout=20)
  ch=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_entity('@VPNCODEIPTV'),timeout=20)
  assert ch.broadcast is True and not ch.megagroup and ch.creator is True,'not_owner_broadcast_channel'
  msg=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_messages(ch,ids=msg_id),timeout=20)
  if msg is None:
   print('HISTORICAL_LEADS_POST_ALREADY_ABSENT',True,'ID',msg_id,flush=True)
   return
  assert getattr(msg,'message',None)==expected,'MESSAGE_CONTENT_DIFFERS_NO_DELETION'
  assert msg.date is not None and msg.date.astimezone(ZoneInfo('Europe/Lisbon')).date().isoformat()==record['day'],'POST_DATE_DIFFERS_NO_DELETION'
  print('LEADS_OWN_POST_EXACT_MATCH',True,'MESSAGE_ID',msg_id,flush=True)
  resp=await asyncio.wait_for(client.delete_messages(ch,[msg_id],revoke=True),timeout=25)
  check=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_messages(ch,ids=msg_id),timeout=20)
  assert check is None,'POST_DELETE_NOT_VERIFIED'
  print('LEADS_OWN_POST_RETRACTED',True,'MESSAGE_ID',msg_id,'OTHER_MESSAGES_TOUCHED',0,flush=True)
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():await asyncio.wait_for(client.disconnect(),timeout=10)
asyncio.run(undo())
print('LEADS_ONLY_CROSS_PROJECT_BOUNDARY_RESTORED',True,flush=True)
